description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'BulkUpdateUsersController' responsible for handling bulk user update operations, specifically deletions, via HTTP requests within a REST API framework. It processes incoming requests, performs user deletions through a repository, and logs audit actions.

classes.name: BulkUpdateUsersController
classes.description: A controller class handling bulk user update operations, mainly deletions, with audit logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with user repository and audit log service dependencies.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests for bulk user updates, performs deletion if specified, and returns the count of successful operations.

methods.name: auditAction
methods.description: Logs the bulk deletion action performed by a user for audit purposes.
